instruction: A candid action photograph captured from a high-angle medium shot. In an indoor judo dojo on yellow tatami mats, the woman with curly hair in a bun (R1) wearing a blue judogi is kneeling and pinning the young man in a white judogi (R2) to the ground. R1's back, which features a white patch labeled 'G. PAIVA POR', is turned toward the camera as she grapples with R2, who lies flat on his back beneath her. The scene is brightly lit with even, soft indoor lighting, casting minimal shadows on the yellow mat.
